mapper.select: select count(distinct t.system_code) as system_count, count(1) as task_count, sum(case when x.result_status = 'NOTSTART' then 1 else 0 end) as not_start_count, sum(case when x.result_status = 'RUNNING' then 1 else 0 end) as running_count, sum(case when x.result_status = 'SUCCESS' then 1 else 0 end) as success_count, sum(case when x.result_status = 'FAILED' then 1 else 0 end) as failed_count from ( select i.task_code, case when i.actual_end_time is not null and i.result_status = 'SUCCESS' then 'SUCCESS' when i.actual_end_time is not null and i.result_status = 'FAILED' then 'FAILED' when i.actual_start_time is not null and i.actual_end_time is null then 'RUNNING' else 'NOTSTART' end as result_status from monitor_task_instance i where i.biz_date = #{bizDate} ) x left join monitor_task t on x.task_code = t.task_code

select s.system_code, s.system_name, s.owner_name, s.supervisor_name, sum(case when x.result_status = 'NOTSTART' then 1 else 0 end) as not_start_count, sum(case when x.result_status = 'RUNNING' then 1 else 0 end) as running_count, sum(case when x.result_status = 'SUCCESS' then 1 else 0 end) as success_count, sum(case when x.result_status = 'FAILED' then 1 else 0 end) as failed_count, count(x.task_code) as total_count from monitor_system s left join ( select i.system_code, i.task_code, case when i.actual_end_time is not null and i.result_status = 'SUCCESS' then 'SUCCESS' when i.actual_end_time is not null and i.result_status = 'FAILED' then 'FAILED' when i.actual_start_time is not null and i.actual_end_time is null then 'RUNNING' else 'NOTSTART' end as result_status from monitor_task_instance i where i.biz_date = #{bizDate} ) x on s.system_code = x.system_code where s.is_flag = '0'
and s.system_name like concat('%', #{systemName}, '%')
group by s.system_code, s.system_name, s.owner_name, s.supervisor_name order by s.system_code asc

select i.biz_date, i.run_times, i.task_code, t.task_name, i.system_code, s.system_name, t.owner_name, t.supervisor_name, t.pre_requisite_prod, t.the_batch_prod, t.pos_x, t.pos_y, t.default_cost_minutes, i.frequency, t.is_flag as task_is_flag, t.remark, case when i.actual_end_time is not null and i.result_status = 'SUCCESS' then 'SUCCESS' when i.actual_end_time is not null and i.result_status = 'FAILED' then 'FAILED' when i.actual_start_time is not null and i.actual_end_time is null and now() > i.predict_end_time then 'DELAYED' when i.actual_start_time is not null and i.latest_start_time is not null and i.actual_start_time > i.latest_start_time then 'DELAYED' when i.actual_start_time is not null and i.actual_end_time is null then 'RUNNING' else 'NOTSTART' end as result_status, i.plan_start_time, i.latest_start_time, i.plan_end_time, i.actual_start_time, i.actual_end_time, i.current_cost_minutes * 60 as current_cost_seconds, i.avg_cost_minutes * 60 as avg_cost_seconds, i.predict_end_time, case when i.actual_start_time is not null and i.latest_start_time is not null and i.actual_start_time > i.latest_start_time then 1 when i.actual_start_time is not null and i.actual_end_time is null and now() > i.predict_end_time then 1 when i.actual_end_time is not null and i.predict_end_time is not null and i.actual_end_time > i.predict_end_time then 1 when i.delayed_flag = 1 then 1 else 0 end as delayed_flag, case when i.actual_start_time is not null and i.actual_end_time is null and now() > i.predict_end_time then 1 when i.actual_end_time is not null and i.predict_end_time is not null and i.actual_end_time > i.predict_end_time then 1 when i.timeout_flag = 1 then 1 else 0 end as timeout_flag, i.is_flag from monitor_task_instance i left join monitor_system s on i.system_code = s.system_code left join monitor_task t on i.task_code = t.task_code where i.biz_date = #{bizDate} order by i.plan_start_time asc, i.task_code asc
select pre_task_code, task_code, direction from monitor_task_dependency d order by pre_task_code asc, task_code asc
